title: Validation-Class Multiplier for Late-Issuance Goodwill on SSL/TLS Certificates
content:
The validation-class multiplier of the late-issuance goodwill follows the certificate product of the subscription on SSL/TLS Certificates: an EV product takes 1.5, an OV product takes 1.25, and a DV product takes one. It multiplies the late-issuance goodwill figure.

| Certificate product | Class | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline EV Single Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain | EV | 1.5 |
| Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard | OV | 1.25 |
| Harborline DV Single Domain, Harborline DV Multi-Domain, Harborline DV Wildcard | DV | 1 |

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
